plan.name: cuda_auto_0885_takeoff
plan.hypothesis: User-requested tenfold duration: recreate the same short-run prefix then continue within one uninterrupted optimizer/environment run; compare reward15/16 with unchanged physical and hover criteria.
plan.limitations: Uncalibrated full particle tether; optimizer resets between bounded runs; no hover/hardware precision claim.
plan.rejection_rule: The first short reward16 seed added escapes and no hover. Requested longer exposure is a falsifiable test, not a promoted method. Require replicated ground sustained-hover improvement with no additional true failures or lost takeoffs; inspect initial/periodic/final and verify exact short prefixes. Do not rank changed reward magnitudes or post-reset altitude.
